name: Block Crush
detailed_description:
Block Crush: A Revolutionary Match Puzzle Game

Crafted over 4 years of dedicated development, Block Crush introduces an unprecedented puzzle experience! Unlike traditional match-3, tap-to-clear, or line-clearing games, our cover-clear mechanism redefines puzzle-solving in match games with strategic depth. Gear up to challenge your mind, master block placement, and crush scores like never before!

Core Gameplay: Strategic Cover Clear

Goal: Use limited block props in each level to precisely cover and clear all squares to complete the stage.
Challenges:
▶ Running out of blocks before clearing all squares = failure – plan every block’s position and coverage carefully;
▶ Collect colorful skill items (e.g., green, blue, red) and combine them strategically for chain eliminations;
▶ Aim for high scores by mastering optimal block placement and skill usage!

Mechanic Highlights:

✔ A unique cover-clearance algorithm ensures each level offers distinct puzzle logic, free from repetitive patterns;
✔ Pause to strategize before dragging blocks – maximize each move’s coverage to clear levels smarter, not harder!

Game Features: Casual Fun Meets Brain-Teasing Depth

Flexible Playtime: From seconds-long quick clears to minutes of deep strategic thinking – perfect for both short breaks and immersive play;

Diverse Modes:
▶ Main Campaign: Meticulously designed levels with escalating difficulty;
▶ Bonus Reward: Unlock beautiful background artworks upon completion – collectible rewards for your achievements;

Genre: Casual Puzzle + Strategic Elimination – suitable for all ages to exercise problem-solving skills.

Why Block Crush?

✅ Innovative Mechanic: Break free from traditional match norms with the "cover" concept;
✅ Craftsmanship: 4 years of refinement ensures every level is logically sound and endlessly engaging;
✅ Easy to Learn, Hard to Master: Simple controls hide layers of strategic depth – once you start, you won’t want to stop!

Start your challenge today – use blocks to build your puzzle-solving legacy and become a cover-clearing master!

short_description: Block Crush is a casual puzzle game that uses blocks to clear cells. For a level, use a limited number of blocks to clear all the cells to pass.While clear blocks, you can gain skills of various colors to help clear. Think a little before dragging and cover as many cells as possible each time.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit OS)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4160 (Haswell and later) / AMD Athlon X4 845 (Excavator and later)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 2GB, GTX 750Ti 2GB, or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible soundcard or onboard chipset
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit OS)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4690 or equivalent / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 770, 2 GB or AMD Radeon R9 380, 4 GB or Intel ARC A580, 8 GB or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible soundcard or onboard chipset
